Typography in UI references: SF Pro, title 13pt medium, dominant value 28pt semibold, body 17pt regular, supporting 13pt regular, action 15pt semibold. All text becomes native localized SwiftUI in production.

Use case: ui-mockup. Asset ID: progressReflection-expanded-dark.
Create one dark LifeBoard ui-reference for "Progress & Reflection". Product intent: Review recorded progress.

Continuous 24-point corners; 16-point inner padding. Text reading region x=16..337, y=16..324; actions occupy the final 44 points before bottom padding. Artwork allocation follows the preset: Glance 72×36-point trailing footer; Compact 64-point footer; Wide 100-point trailing column with 72-point artwork height (stack below content if width cannot preserve a 220-point reading column); Story 112-point header; Expanded 144-point footer. keep a solid surface behind every text and control pixel. Native UI has priority over illustration. Arrange for Expanded: more evidence and up to four relevant rows, without repeating content.
Exact synthetic copy only: title "Progress & Reflection"; value "Small steps count"; supporting "Look back at what you recorded"; action "View reflection". Maximum visible data rows 4. Do not invent additional values or controls.
Palette: surface #282A44, primary ink #F7F1E7, secondary ink #C9C3B8, warm accent #E5B96D. Assistant violet #6842FF only for Saved Eva Insight.
Subject: Winding landscape path. Cohesive editorial gouache mini scene, visible soft brush texture, restrained depth, recognizable shapes, generous quiet space. Soft indigo ambient light with parchment highlights; preserve silhouettes and contrast.
Typography in UI references: SF Pro, title 13pt medium, dominant value 28pt semibold, body 17pt regular, supporting 13pt regular, action 15pt semibold. All text becomes native localized SwiftUI in production.
State: synthetic sample, never real user data. No invented completion, health claims, before/after bodies, literal meal reconstruction, logos, watermarks, device frames, outside captions or extra panels. No new mascot; respect selected assistant identity.

Native UI has priority over illustration. Arrange for Wide: horizontal hierarchy and up to three relevant rows; preserve readable text width.
Exact synthetic copy only: title "Life Moment"; value "A day to remember"; supporting "Family picnic · 22 September"; action "View moment". Maximum visible data rows 3. Do not invent additional values or controls.

Subject: Celebratory still life. Cohesive editorial gouache mini scene, visible soft brush texture, restrained depth, recognizable shapes, generous quiet space. Warm diffuse daylight.
Typography in UI references: SF Pro, title 13pt medium, dominant value 28pt semibold, body 17pt regular, supporting 13pt regular, action 15pt semibold. All text becomes native localized SwiftUI in production.
State: synthetic sample, never real user data. No invented completion, health claims, before/after bodies, literal meal reconstruction, logos, watermarks, device frames, outside captions or extra panels. No new mascot; respect selected assistant identity.

Create one dark LifeBoard production-scene for "Log Meal". Product intent: Record a meal.
Requested canvas and final export: exactly 1024 × 1024 pixels. Fully transparent RGBA background. Place the scene within x=384..960, y=128..896. Keep x=0..352 fully transparent; keep 64 pixels clearance from every edge. Soft natural painterly fade into genuine transparency, no checkerboard. Crop anchor x=0.75, y=0.5. No text, letters, numbers, charts, rings, buttons, symbols pretending to be controls, UI chrome or card silhouette.
No visible copy. This is an illustration asset, not a UI mockup.
Palette: surface #282A44, primary ink #F7F1E7, secondary ink #C9C3B8, warm accent #E5B96D. Assistant violet #6842FF only for Saved Eva Insight.
Subject: Plate and sketchbook. Cohesive editorial gouache mini scene, visible soft brush texture, restrained depth, recognizable shapes, generous quiet space. Soft indigo ambient light with parchment highlights; preserve silhouettes and contrast.
Typography in UI references: SF Pro, title 13pt medium, dominant value 28pt semibold, body 17pt regular, supporting 13pt regular, action 15pt semibold. All text becomes native localized SwiftUI in production.
State: synthetic sample, never real user data. No invented completion, health claims, before/after bodies, literal meal reconstruction, logos, watermarks, device frames, outside captions or extra panels. No new mascot; respect selected assistant identity.
Preserve aspect ratio; never stretch. If output dimensions differ, record actual dimensions and export by aspect-preserving crop/resample only; regenerate if any essential content would be cut.
Output: DesignAssets/Sources/HomeCards/logMeal-scene-dark.png. PNG. Alpha required: true.
Acceptance: correct subject, exact hierarchy and copy where applicable, safe reading field, clear actions, consistent painterly style, no clipped essential content, verified final dimensions and alpha.
specification_history.note: Previous specification; not proof of exact historical submission.
